"""Order item TSV row serializer."""
from typing import List
from item import OrderItem
from catalog_validator import validate_catalog
import csv
from io import StringIO

def serialize_item_row(item: OrderItem) -> str:
    """Serialize OrderItem into a TSV formatted audit line."""
    # Use csv module to properly escape TSV fields
    output = StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(output, delimiter='\t', quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
    writer.writerow([item.item_id, item.description])
    result = output.getvalue().rstrip('\n')  # Remove trailing newline
    return result

def serialize_catalog(items: List[OrderItem]) -> str:
    if not validate_catalog(items):
        raise ValueError("Invalid catalog items")
    return "\n".join(serialize_item_row(i) for i in items)

def count_serialized_items(catalog_str: str) -> int:
    return len([line for line in catalog_str.splitlines() if line.strip()])

import pytest
from item import OrderItem
from serializer import serialize_item_row

def test_item_quote_escaping():
    item = OrderItem("ITM-2", 'Widget "Pro" Edition')
    assert serialize_item_row(item) == 'ITM-2\t"Widget ""Pro"" Edition"'

def test_item_multiline_escaping():
    item = OrderItem("ITM-3", "Widget\nMulti\nLine")
    assert serialize_item_row(item) == 'ITM-3\t"Widget\nMulti\nLine"'

def test_item_complex_escaping():
    item = OrderItem("ITM-4", 'Widget "Pro" Edition\nwith "quotes"')
    assert serialize_item_row(item) == 'ITM-4\t"Widget ""Pro"" Edition\nwith ""quotes"""'
